name: Accent Line Name
description: A glowing accent line grows low-left with a bright node riding its head. The name rises letter by letter out of the line and the role drops out beneath it, then a glint runs along the line; at the end both sink back into the line and it retracts to the right.

sample.subtitle: Former head, Southern Nevada Water Authority

name: Two-Tone Name Blocks
description: The name sits on a white block with an accent edge that wipes in from the left, and the role sits on an accent block that wipes in from the right. Both have hard cut-out shadows and drift apart slightly while they hold, then collapse back toward the sides they came from.

name: Glass Name Card
description: A frosted-glass card tilts up into place in 3D and floats gently. A gold icon circle pops in, draws its ring and person glyph, the name and role rise letter by letter, and a diagonal shine sweeps across the glass before the card tips away.

name: Location Pin Drop
description: A map pin drops in, squashes and hops on landing, and ground ripples keep pulsing under its tip. The place name rises letter by letter with the region in accent caps, a hairline draws, and the real coordinates decode in mono: digits scramble in cyan, then lock.

name: Date And Place
description: A glowing accent divider grows from its centre. The date slides out of it to the left and the place slides out of it to the right, both in mono caps with small DATE and LOCATION captions and a hairline beneath; at the end they slide back into the divider as it closes.

name: Initials Role Badge
description: A gold coin with the person's initials flips in on its Y axis with a slight overshoot, its accent ring draws on and a dashed orbit ring keeps turning. The name rises letter by letter beside it and the role wipes open inside an outlined pill; at the end the coin flips away.

name: Corner Bracket Tag
description: A tiny top-left tag with four accent corner brackets that lock onto the text from outside with an overshoot and a glow flash. A scan line passes through it, a status dot blinks, the brackets breathe while it holds, and they spring back open as the letters drop out.

name: Stacked Index Profile
description: A large outline index number rolls in like an odometer and then fills with accent colour behind a moving wave. An accent bar grows beside it, and the name, role and organisation rows slide up out of their masks one after another, split by hairlines that draw in.

name: Slant Bar Drawer
description: A compact skewed accent bar whips in from the left, trailing speed streaks and led by a white sliver, and the name rises letter by letter inside it. A thin dark role drawer then drops out from under the bar, a glint crosses it, and the bar whips out to the right.

name: Source Credit Line
description: A small bottom-right credit line reading FOOTAGE: SOURCE in mono caps, its characters rising and fading in one by one. Beside it sits a play icon whose ring draws on, then an accent progress arc fills slowly as the shot plays; the characters drop out right to left at the end.

name: Word Stack Slam
description: Two to four condensed words stack on the left, each dropping from 1.8x scale and landing with a speed streak, an outline shockwave and a small camera shake. An accent spine grows beside the stack as each word lands, the key word is in the accent, and at the end the words wipe out one by one.

name: Split Line Reveal
description: A hairline with end ticks draws out from the centre, then splits into two rules that move apart while the headline slides up out of the gap between them. An accent glint runs along the rules, and at the end the gap closes over the text and the line pulls back to the centre.

sample.text: The River That Stopped Reaching The Sea
sample.subtitle: Colorado River Delta, Mexico

name: Wipe Bar Reveal
description: An After Effects block reveal in the lower left: an accent bar wipes across each headline line and pulls away to leave the words behind, with a white bar doing the same for the subtitle and an accent spine beside them. At the end the bars wipe back over the text and carry it away.

sample.text: Arizona Cuts Water To Its Farms
sample.subtitle: Pinal County, January 2023

name: Keyword Scale Pop
description: A bold sentence near the bottom centre rises word by word out of masks. Then the key word grows about 1.36x in the accent, the other words move aside to make room, and an accent underline and a ring of eight spark strokes burst out. At the end the words rise back out of their masks.

sample.text: Forty million people depend on a single river
sample.subtitle: The Colorado River

name: Focus Pull Title
description: Words come from a soft, scaled-up blur into sharp focus one after another, with rimmed bokeh discs drifting in parallax behind them. Camera focus brackets close in and flash the accent when the last word is sharp. At the end the words go soft again and fall back into depth.

name: 3D Letter Flip
description: A top-centre headline whose letters roll in one after another on the X axis like the faces of a cube, in perspective with shading, overshooting slightly before they settle. An accent bar and a tracked subtitle follow underneath, and at the end the letters roll away in turn.

name: Outline To Fill
description: On a slowly settling navy backdrop of dotted ridges, a stroked title rises in letter by letter, then fills with solid white (the key word in the accent) from left to right behind a slanted glinting edge while an accent glow builds. An accent rule and a tracked subtitle follow.

name: Marker Sweep
description: An editorial headline in heavy near-black sans on warm fibred paper rises word by word. Then a translucent, rough-edged accent highlighter sweeps behind the key words with its tip leading, under an accent-square kicker, with a source line below. At the end the highlighter lifts off and the words rise away.

sample.text: The aquifer under the Great Plains is being drained faster than rain can refill it
sample.subtitle: The Ogallala Aquifer
sample.label: Source: U.S. Geological Survey

name: Center Stack Title
description: A centred three-weight stack: a widely tracked accent kicker, a big condensed title rising letter by letter, and a light note line. Fading hairline rules above and below the title draw outward from accent diamonds, and at the end everything leaves in turn as the rules pull back to the centre.

sample.text: The Dam That Drowned Glen Canyon
sample.subtitle: Chapter Two
sample.label: Page, Arizona, 1963

name: Ticker Slide
description: A compact, skewed accent band slides in from the left in the lower corner, with its headline following slightly behind so the two layers separate. Two trailing notches follow, a white kicker chip rises out from behind the band, and a sheen sweeps across once. At the end the text slides out of the band and the band wipes away.

sample.label: Update
sample.subtitle: The reservoir fell to 22% of capacity in February 2023

name: Wipe Slider Compare
description: A large framed photo pair on a dark stage: a white divider with a glass handle is dragged from the right edge to far left, then overshoots back and settles past the middle. THEN (graded archival) and NOW labels are wiped by the divider and the frame collapses to a line on exit.

name: Parallax Triptych
description: Three tall panels rise into place from alternating sides with masked reveals while the pictures inside counter-move. A single photo is sliced across all three and snaps into alignment. Panels drift at different pan speeds, carry numbered captions, and close away staggered.

name: 3D Photo Carousel
description: Photos on a 3D ring spin in and land with the front card enlarged and lit and a floor reflection below. The ring then steps one photo at a time with a mono counter and caption swapping letter by letter, and spins away at the end.

name: Corkboard Pins
description: On a warm speckled cork board with a slow camera drift, a taped index card with a marker title lands first. Photo prints then drop in with closing shadows, a pin falls into each, and each print swings on its pin before settling into a faint sway; everything is yanked off the board at the end.

name: Double Exposure
description: A graded base photo slowly pushes while a second photo (or a mirrored copy) is screen-blended in through a travelling diagonal mask. An accent light leak sweeps and flickers across the frame, and the look exits in a burn-out flash under a bottom-left title.

name: Zoom Through
description: Photo 1 settles, then a bordered window pops open at its centre with cyan finder brackets and a rolling ZOOM readout. The camera dives in with motion blur and a flash until photo 2 fills the frame, and the title rises bottom-left.

name: Annotated Photo
description: A photo is swept by a cyan scan line that leaves a faint grid behind. Numbered markers pop with pulsing rings, curved white arrows draw on to them with arrowheads snapping in, and condensed labels with detail lines rise beside each; the arrows undraw on exit.

items.label: Intake pipe
items.text: Drew straight from the Flint River

name: Grid Pop Mosaic
description: A 2x2 (or 3x2) photo grid pops in diagonally with back-out scale, tilt and a camera-flash flicker per cell. The gutters then close as the grid grows into a full-bleed mosaic, a centred title rises over a soft dark pool, and the cells flip away in 3D at the end.

sample.text: Every Photo Tells The Same Story
sample.subtitle: Drought across the West

name: Parallax Depth Stack
description: Three layers: a blurred dark back photo, a large mid card and a white-bordered front print that flies in from near the lens. They truck sideways at three speeds with drifting dust motes and an accent light beam, then the camera pushes through the layers on exit.

sample.text: The Last Farm In The Valley
sample.subtitle: San Joaquin, California
sample.label: Fallowed since 2015

name: Photo Date Plate
description: A photo is wiped on behind a glowing accent edge (archival grade for older years) and crop marks draw into the corners. A dark angled plate backed by an accent plate slides over the bottom-right corner while the year rolls in as an odometer, then both plates slide back out.

name: Numbered Cascade
description: Paper-white numbered cards fall one after another into a diagonal cascade, tilted back in 3D with shadows tightening as they land, an accent number block and words rising out of masks, a sheen sweeping each card, then folding away in turn.

sample.text: Why the Colorado is drying up

items.label: Over-allocation
items.text: The 1922 compact promised water that never existed

items.label: Rising heat
items.text: Warmer air steals snowpack before it melts

items.label: Thirsty farms
items.text: Agriculture takes about 70% of the river

items.label: Growing cities
items.text: 40 million people now depend on it

name: Checklist Ticks
description: A checklist on the left of the footage: rows rise in, each box draws its outline, then in sequence a box fills with the accent, a tick draws through it with a ripple, the row brightens and a progress bar counts it up.

name: Pros And Cons
description: Two columns split by a divider drawing from the centre, a green plus badge and a red minus badge spinning in over tinted columns, the points landing left, right, left, right with little plus and minus rings drawing on as the words rise.

name: Top Five Countdown
description: A giant rank numeral rolls 5 to 1 with motion blur while ranked rows slide in from the bottom of the list upward, values rolling, and number one lands last in an enlarged top slot with an accent wipe and glow flash as the others dim.

name: Icon Bullet Grid
description: A crosshair draws out from the centre to split a 2x2 grid, then clockwise each cell's geometric line icon (drop, bolt, house, coin, warning, leaf or a plain shape) draws on and fills with a rippling accent liquid as its label and line rise beside it.

sample.text: Four ways a city runs dry

items.label: Leaking pipes
items.text: Old mains lose a third of treated water

name: Process Chevrons
description: Interlocking chevrons draw their outlines left to right, then light up in turn as the accent pours through each, the active step lifting with a glow and its label brightening below, finished by a sheen running through the whole row.

name: Cycle Loop
description: Three to five numbered nodes pop in round a ring, arcs draw between them and grow arrowheads, accent dashes then flow round the loop while a comet circles and lights each node it passes, a dashed outer ring turning slowly around the centred title.

items.label: Evaporation
items.text: The sun lifts water from the oceans

items.label: Collection
items.text: Rivers carry it back to sea

name: Pyramid Levels
description: On the dark case-file desktop a pyramid builds bottom-up, each shaded trapezoid level dropping and settling onto the one below with a flash line, the apex in the accent, and dashed leaders drawing out to labels that rise beside each level.

items.label: Junior users
items.text: First to be cut in a shortage

name: Funnel Stages
description: On a drifting graphite gradient mesh a funnel's stage outlines draw, then the accent pours down through it stage by stage with a bright leading edge, each value rolling as the pour reaches it, labels rising on the left and red drop-off pills popping between stages on the right.

name: Tab Reveal
description: An accordion of white tabs slides in on the right of the footage and opens one tab at a time, its chevron turning and number chip going accent while its lines rise and a progress bar runs along its foot, then folds shut as the next one opens.

items.label: Collection points
items.text: About 200 sites hand out 25 litres a person

items.label: Hospitals first
items.text: Critical services keep a priority supply

name: Giant Quote Marks
description: Oversized drawn accent quote marks spin and scale in over a faint drifting ghost mark, the quote rises line by line out of masks with key words in the accent, then the speaker slides out beside a drawn accent rule as the closing mark rotates in.

sample.text: We were told the water was safe to drink. It never was.
sample.label: Former city employee
sample.subtitle: Congressional hearing, 2016

name: Testimony Rail
description: On a dark designed backdrop, an accent rail draws down with a glowing tip. Each quote line slides out of the rail as the tip passes it, tick marks light up, and the speaker's name and role rise at the foot beside a diamond node that keeps pulsing.

sample.text: By the time the samples came back, the lead levels were off the charts. Nobody wanted to say it out loud.
sample.label: Water plant operator
sample.subtitle: Sworn testimony, 2016

name: Pull-Quote Panel
description: A frosted glass panel slides in from the right over the playing footage with a parallax lag. Its accent edge draws down, a quote mark pops, the words rise one by one with key words in the accent, and the speaker rises under a hairline before the panel slides back out.

sample.text: The river is not running dry. We are drinking it dry.
sample.label: Hydrologist
sample.subtitle: Colorado River Research Group

name: Statement Vs Reality
description: The official statement rises word by word. Two rules then draw outward as a bouncing accent BUT drops between them with a soft flash and a camera punch, the statement dims and shrinks, and the reality rises letter by letter in big accent capitals.

sample.text: Officials said the reservoir would recover by spring
sample.subtitle: It dropped another 30 feet
sample.label: The official line

name: Strike Correction
description: A claim rises under a small CLAIM tag and a red bar strikes through each line, led by a hot white spark. The claim shakes, dims and moves up, and the correction rises letter by letter in large capitals beneath an accent kicker.

sample.text: Lake Mead will refill on its own
sample.subtitle: It needs years of record snowfall
sample.label: The reality

name: Karaoke Highlight
description: The sentence rises in white. Each word then fills left to right with the accent in speaking rhythm (longer words take longer), lifting slightly with a glowing underline that trails off, and the speaker is tagged beneath.

sample.text: Every drop that comes out of this tap has travelled three hundred miles through the desert
sample.label: Arizona farmer

name: Emphasis Zoom Word
description: A sentence rises in big condensed capitals and the key word's underline charges. The camera then dives into that word with motion blur while the rest fall away, the word turns accent, and focus brackets snap around it during a slow push.

sample.text: Nobody was ever held responsible for the poisoning

name: Said-By Stamp
description: The quote rises word by word. A circular seal then slams down from above with a camera shake, a shock ring and a burst of sparks; the speaker's name runs round its ring and the seal keeps turning slowly.

sample.text: If we keep pumping at this rate, the wells in this valley will be dry within a generation.
sample.label: County water board

name: Double Quote Cards
description: Two cards rise showing their accent backs, then flip over in 3D one after the other with a spring settle and shading to reveal two short opposing quotes. A light sheen crosses each card and the speakers appear under hairlines, then the cards flip away.

items.label: City official, 2014
items.text: The water meets every federal safety standard.

items.label: Resident, 2015
items.text: My kids broke out in rashes every time they took a bath.

name: Whisper Subtitle
description: A cinematic lowercase line sits low on the footage. Letters rise from the centre outward while wide tracking closes in, a hairline draws out from a glowing accent dot, and the speaker appears below in small spaced capitals before the line tracks back out.

sample.text: They said the water would always be there.
sample.label: Rancher, Imperial Valley

name: Chapter Number Roll
description: On a dark card with a pulsing accent glow, a huge two-digit chapter number spins into place on odometer wheels, an accent rule grows beside it as the kicker and title rise letter by letter, and a thin segmented progress line draws across the bottom with the current chapter filling in the accent.

name: Part Divider
description: Over drifting navy dotted ridges, two fine rules draw outward from the centre, the top one framing a tracked PART II label and the bottom one a popping accent diamond, with the title rising letter by letter between them and the rules retracting to the centre at the end.

sample.text: The River That Built the West

name: Episode Card
description: A dark gradient card flips in on a 3D turn over the darkened footage, its big outline episode number drawing on stroke by stroke with an accent glow, the title rising beside it and a light sheen sweeping across the card before it flips away.

name: Letterbox Title
description: Black cinema bars slide in from the top and bottom over the playing footage, the title rises letter by letter in the gap and slowly tracks wider, with a kicker in the top bar and a subtitle in the bottom bar, then the bars slide away.

name: Glitch Resolve Title
description: Over darkened footage, the title appears as jittering cyan and accent RGB-split slices with a scan line and brief scanlines, then snaps into a clean title within about half a second and holds clean, with a mono kicker, an accent rule and a subtitle rising in.

name: Chrome Light Sweep
description: In a dark studio under a drifting spotlight, a chrome title with an accent rim rises line by line while its tracking closes up, a glossy light band sweeps across the letters twice, and its reflection fades into the floor below.

name: Chapter Fraction
description: Low-left over the footage, a big 02 and a smaller 05 spin into place on digit wheels while an accent slash draws between them and chapter segments pop in beneath, with the current one filling, and the kicker and title rise letter by letter beside a growing divider.

name: Coordinates Title
description: Low-left over the footage, a mini dark globe spins and tilts onto the place while targeting brackets close in and lock in the accent, a pin pulses, and beside it the place kicker and title rise as a mono lat/lon readout scrambles in cyan and locks digit by digit to the true coordinates.

name: Year Tape Title
description: On a light warm-grey card, a mechanical year counter rolls up through the decades to the year while a timeline tape of year ticks scrolls under an accent needle, then the title rises letter by letter beneath with an accent rule.

name: Countdown to Chapter
description: A 3-2-1 countdown with rolling numerals inside a ring, an accent arc and radar wedge sweeping each count over a rotating tick dial, then a shockwave and particle burst as the ring shrinks into an emblem holding the chapter number above the title, which rises letter by letter.

name: Marker Circle Pulse
description: A gold marker loop draws a little more than one full turn around the subject so its ends overlap like a real pen stroke, bumps as it closes and sends out soft pulse rings, while a short kicker and title rise letter by letter beside it on a white tick.

name: Pigtail Arrow Label
description: The label rises in first, then an accent arrow draws out of it on a bowed curve with a looping pigtail, its head flicks open at the end and a ring bursts on the target point before the arrow retracts at the exit.

name: Measured Bracket
description: A crisp white square bracket grows outward from its centre beside a region with fine ruler ticks and a faint accent wash; an accent notch points to the label, an optional value rolls like an odometer and a gold highlight keeps sliding along the spine.

name: Target Lock Reticle
description: A large reticle turned 45 degrees hunts across the subject between seeded guesses, settles, snaps shut and blinks gold to lock; cyan crosshair lines shoot out, a range ring turns, the mono status flips from SCANNING to TARGET LOCKED and the coordinates decode digit by digit.

name: Dimension Line
description: End ticks snap in and dashed witness lines reach toward the object, then a dimension line shoots out from the centre with gold arrowheads riding its ends; the value rolls above it (or beside it when label is vertical/height/depth), the caption rises below and a laser dot keeps sweeping along the line.

name: Water Drop Ripple
description: A gold drop falls onto the point, squashes into a marker dot and sends perspective-flattened water ripples across the surface; a leader line climbs to an elbow and runs out under the label, the title rising above the line and the subtitle dropping in below it.

name: Typing Quote Bubble
description: A small white bubble with three bouncing typing dots springs out of the speaker, then morphs open into a clean minimal quote bubble with a curved tail; the words rise in line by line behind a gold accent bar under the speaker's name, and the bubble shrinks back into the speaker at the end.

sample.text: We haven't had clean water in three years.
sample.label: Flint resident

name: Marker Scribble Underline
description: A short statement rises in big condensed caps letter by letter, then a three-pass gold marker scribble tears back and forth under the key word and keeps a subtle hand-drawn line boil while it holds before it erases in stroke order.

sample.text: The river never reached the sea
sample.subtitle: Colorado River Delta

name: Searchlight Spotlight
description: The frame dims and desaturates while a soft pool of light sweeps in from off the subject, tightens onto it and gently breathes; a gold ring draws around the pool, the label steps out on an elbow line and at the end the iris opens back to the full picture.

name: Swinging Fact Chips
description: A connector climbs from a pulsing dot on the subject to a joint, a spine drops from it and two or three white key/value chips swing down one after another on a springy 3D hinge with their numbers rolling, then fold back up in reverse at the end.

name: Times Bigger Bars
description: A grey reference bar lands, a dashed guide drops from its end, then an accent bar grows notch by notch (x1, x2, x3 markers rising as the glowing head passes) to N times its length and a big 'xN' odometer rolls in beside it.

name: Fraction Pie
description: A pie outlined into its slices pops in with a rotating dotted rim; the counted slices fly in radially one by one with a back-out snap while a stacked numerator-over-denominator fraction rolls and the title rises letter by letter.

sample.text: of Colorado River water goes to farming

name: KPI Flip Grid
description: Up to four dark glass KPI tiles flip in on the Y axis one after another in 3D, each with an accent edge, rising label, rolling value, a filling hairline meter and a light sheen, then flip away at the end.

name: Before After Slider
description: A panel opens like a barn door showing the 'before' value; a white slider handle sweeps across and wipes the red- or green-tinted 'after' state over it while the new number rolls, then a struck-through 'WAS' line and a change pill appear.

name: Change Meter
description: Low-left on the footage, a red-to-green minus/plus scale unfolds from zero, then a white needle springs with overshoot to the percent change, lighting the ticks it passes while the signed value rolls above it.

name: Dual Dial Gauges
description: Two 270-degree speedometer dials sit side by side; each arc and needle springs up in turn with the ticks lighting as the fill passes, the needles keep a faint quiver, and the values roll in the open base of each dial.

name: Spotlight Podium
description: On a dark stage with a perspective floor grid, the 3rd, 2nd and 1st podium blocks rise out of the floor with a back-out bounce, then a spotlight snaps on over the accent-colored winner with a ray burst and drifting dust while the values roll above.

sample.text: Where the world's fresh water goes

name: Tug of War
description: A braided rope draws outward from the centre between two labeled sides; the knot and its accent pennant jitter at the centre line, then are hauled by a spring toward the bigger value as the braid slides, and the winning share rolls in under the knot with a direction chevron.

name: Goal Track
description: A track draws on while a goal flag is hoisted and waves at the finish; a glowing runner streaks along to the share of the goal, 25/50/75% milestones ping as it passes, a percent chip rides above it and the amount rolls in the headline.

name: Stacked Blocks
description: Accent blocks (up to 50, one per unit or a nice unit each) drop with gravity and stack row by row into a grid, squashing as they land, while the counter beside them rolls in sync; a light sweep then glides across the finished stack.

sample.text: people depend on the Colorado River
sample.subtitle: One river

name: Polaroid Drop
description: A polaroid falls onto a dark lamp-lit desk with rotation and a shadow that tightens as it nears, lands with a small bump, develops from grey-green emulsion to full colour, and its caption is handwritten letter by letter on the white margin (an optional second print lies underneath); it lifts off the desk at the end.

name: 3D Tilt Card
description: A thick photo block flips in from edge-on on a dotted navy stage and sways in 3D with parallax inside the frame, a gloss sweep, visible edges and a floor reflection, while the kicker, title and body rise beside it; it flips away edge-on at the end.

sample.subtitle: The concrete wall that tamed the Colorado River

name: Blinds Reveal
description: Twelve dark vertical blind slats turn open left to right in perspective over a full-frame photo as it brightens and settles back, the caption lines rise out of their masks beside a growing accent bar, and the blinds close again right to left at the end.

name: Spotlight Focus
description: The photo sits almost black while a soft spotlight with dust drifting in its beam sweeps a searching curve and locks onto the subject (overlay.anchor or centre) with a tightening ring and accent ticks, a leader line draws to the label, and the light floods the whole frame at the end.

name: Film Strip Pull
description: A warm 35 mm film strip with sprocket holes and mono edge codes races in from the right with motion blur and stops on its centre frame, which is pulled out and enlarged into a bordered print while the strip dims and softens behind it; the caption rises below and everything races off to the left.

name: Mosaic Assemble
description: Over a blurred copy of itself, the photo builds from forty tiles flying in from the camera in a diagonal wave, tumbling in 3D and brightening as they land; the seams close, a gloss sweeps across, a frame with accent corners draws on, and the tiles scatter toward the camera at the end.

name: Torn Paper Reveal
description: A sheet of cream paper covering the frame tears away to a jagged torn edge with a white fibrous rim and a cast shadow, revealing the photo and leaving a paper panel where the ink title rises letter by letter with an accent rule and body lines; the panel slides off to the left at the end.

sample.label: Chapter 2
sample.subtitle: Since the 1960s the Colorado has rarely reached the Gulf of California.

name: Magnifier Lens
description: A clean loupe with a light bezel and glass highlight glides in on an arc over the dimmed photo and enlarges the detail beneath it, the zoom pulling in as it lands (a mono x2.3 readout wipes open), with a dashed leader to the label; the lens slides away at the end.

name: Scan ID Frame
description: On a dark cyan HUD grid, corner brackets snap onto a portrait photo panel, a glowing scan line resolves the picture from cyan monochrome to colour, a detection box and ID tag lock on, the name rises letter by letter and mono readouts type in with a rolling metric and a segment bar; the screen collapses like a CRT switching off at the end.

name: Ken Burns Vignette
description: A full-frame photo fades up from black and pushes slowly in a direction chosen by the picture, under a teal-and-amber grade, soft vignette, fine film grain and sliding letterbox bars; a lower caption's kicker and title rise letter by letter above a drawn rule and accent diamond.

name: Year Scroller Lens
description: A ruler of years with quarter ticks races sideways under a glass magnifying lens, decelerates and clicks into the target year with a detent wobble, the year turning accent and underlined, then the ruler whooshes on as the lens shrinks away.

name: Milestone Spine
description: A glowing spine draws down the frame and, as its tip passes each milestone, the node pops accent with a ring and a card wipes out of the spine alternating left and right with the year and a line rising out of masks, folding back in at the end.

items.text: Lake Mead hits a record high

name: Era Bands
description: Eras wipe in as staggered bands along a year axis, then a NOW marker with a mono year readout sweeps left to right painting each band it crosses, the current era glowing accent and past eras turning white.

name: Calendar Flip
description: A desk calendar tilts up out of perspective and flips its pages over the binding in 3D, fast then slowing, through eleven earlier days, months or years to the date, which is then circled with a hand-drawn accent marker loop.

name: Time Passing Clock
description: A minimal clock face whose hands whirl many turns with an accent motion-trail fan and a rim filling up, then brake and settle with a wobble while the number rolls beside it with YEARS and LATER rising in letter by letter.

sample.label: LATER
sample.text: The reservoir was a shadow of itself

name: Decade Roulette Grid
description: Twelve decade cells pop in on a diagonal wave, an accent selector races round them like a roulette wheel and lands on the target decade, which fills with accent while a zoom cone opens onto its ten years with the exact year lit.

sample.text: The decade of the Dust Bowl

name: Curved Path Events
description: A glowing accent line draws along a winding S-shaped road with the camera easing after its head, each event node popping with a ring as it passes and its year and caption rising out of masks above or below the road, then the line erases away.

name: Years Later Card
description: A cinematic time-jump card on its own graphite backdrop: a hairline flashes and irises open into a letterboxed frame, fast-forward streaks rush past while the big number rolls, YEARS LATER rises in with tightening tracking, and the card collapses back into the hairline.

name: Ink Date Stamp
description: A round rubber stamp spins in large and slams onto the footage top right with a squash, shake, ink ring and splatter, its ring text and date printing letter by letter in rough speckled ink before it lifts away.

name: Then Now Years
description: The THEN year card flips in on a 3D hinge with its year rolling, an accent arrow crosses the gap popping a tick at every decade while the elapsed span counts up above it, and the NOW card flips in as the arrow arrives.

name: Twin Lines
description: Two smooth series lines (accent and cyan) draw left to right together behind a linked white scanner, the gap between them shades in, and each line ends in a pulsing dot with its name and rolling end value plus a GAP readout.

name: Step Chart Flags
description: A glowing stepped line draws across a dark grid; as the head passes each step a flag pole rises and a swallowtail value flag unfurls and gently waves (the last in the accent), then a green/red change pill pops in.

name: Range Bars
description: Rows of min-max ranges: each bar grows outward from its centre in a white-to-accent gradient while the hollow min dot and accent max dot slide apart carrying their counting values, the widest range highlighted with a pulsing ring.

name: Stacked Stream
description: A centred streamgraph whose smooth layered ribbons inflate one after another with a springy overshoot behind a glowing playhead that sweeps across reading out the year, ending with colour-keyed end values and layer names on the right.

name: Donut Legend
description: A thick multi-slice ring is swept clockwise by a glowing comet inside a slowly turning tick dial, each legend row wiping in and rolling its value the moment its slice is reached, then the largest slice pops outward with its share in the centre.

name: Treemap Cut
description: A squarified treemap whose tiles are cut in one after another by a glowing white knife edge, largest first, the biggest tile in the accent with a sheen sweep, labels and rolling values rising inside each tile and the total in the corner.

name: Flow Split
description: A sankey-lite: one trunk of flow pours left to right and splits along smooth curves into branches sized by value, light streaks running continuously inside each ribbon, branch nodes growing at the end with rolling values and shares.

name: Scatter Bubbles
description: Bubbles fly out of the centre on curved paths and land on a 2D grid with a ripple each, a dashed trend line draws through the cloud, and the highlighted point glows in the accent with crosshair lines and axis readout chips.

sample.subtitle: Western U.S. cities
sample.label: Annual rainfall (inches) | Gallons per person per day

name: Slope Chart
description: Two axes (then and now) draw down, then each item's line draws across from its left dot to its right dot in green if it rose or red if it fell, landing with a ripple and a change label, a light spark running along the biggest mover.

name: Radar Chart
description: A spider web of 3-8 axes draws on ring by ring, a dashed reference polygon eases out, the accent value polygon springs out vertex by vertex with overshoot and breathes, and a translucent radar beam sweeps the web while axis labels and values rise in.

name: Bar Race
description: Horizontal bars start one after another and race: when a bigger bar overtakes, the rows glide into rank order, values count up at the bar ends, the current leader turns to the accent and an overtaking bar flashes a green chevron; the subtitle (a year) sits as a big ghost figure in the corner.

name: Stacked Column Drop
description: A wireframe 3D column draws on, then each share drops in from above as a solid shaded block that lands on the stack with a squash and a white edge flash, while leader lines draw from each block to its rolling percentage and name (a missing remainder becomes 'Other').

name: Grouped Bars
description: Pairs of columns per label: the 'then' bar is a hatched ghost whose outline draws on like a pen stroke, the 'now' bar rises solid in the accent beside it, both values roll above, and a red or green change chip pops over each pair, with a legend naming the two series from label 'A|B'.

name: Lollipop Chart
description: Rows of dotted tracks where each stem shoots out from zero with a bead on its tip, the head pops to full size with a shock ring on landing and the value rolls beside it, the highlighted row in the accent, then a cyan dashed AVG line drops through all rows.

sample.text: Water used per person, per day

name: Dot Plot
description: One long ruler draws on with its ticks popping as the line passes, then each value is a dot that slides from the left end to its mark with a comet trail, lands with a pulse ring and grows a thin stem to a tiered callout (rolling value and name) above or below the axis.

name: Waterfall Chart
description: A running total: the first item rises as a white starting column, each next item steps off the previous level up in green or down in red with its signed amount rising in, dashed connectors draw across between steps, and a final glowing accent column rises to the net total with a rolling figure.

name: Bullet Target Chart
description: Qualitative bands wipe open along a wide track, the white target marker drops in from above with a bounce, the accent value bar races toward it while the big number rolls, and a bracket draws the gap with a red 'SHORT' or green 'OVER' amount plus a percent-of-target readout.

name: Radial Bars
description: Concentric 270-degree rings sweep clockwise from twelve o'clock to each value with a bead on the tip and the live number riding just ahead of it, names sitting at each ring's start, the highlighted ring glowing in the accent with its figure rolling in the centre, and the rings unwind on exit.

sample.text: How full are the West's reservoirs?
sample.subtitle: Share of capacity, summer 2022

name: Heat Strip
description: A row of year cells coloured from dark through the accent to white-hot flips up one after another on a bottom hinge like a departures board, each value rising inside its cell, then a light sweeps along the strip, the peak cell glows under a PEAK pointer and a gradient legend wipes in with the low and high ends.

name: Histogram Wave
description: Up to 24 thin columns rise in a left-to-right wave with a slight overshoot and then breathe in a slow travelling ripple, while the highlighted column turns to the accent and a leader line draws up from it to a callout with its rolling value and name; the columns sink back in a reverse wave at the end.

name: Speedometer Gauge
description: A 220-degree speedometer dial draws on, its ticks sweep in and light up as a tapered needle springs to the share with a slight overshoot and live wobble, while the figure rolls in under the pivot and the needle drops back to zero on exit.

name: LED Digital Counter
description: A dark seven-segment LED panel opens like a CRT from a bright line, flashes an 888 self-test, counts up to the figure with an amber glow, scanlines and a glass sheen, then powers off segment by segment and collapses back to a line.

name: Split-Flap Counter
description: Split-flap cards rise in and clatter through a full cycle of digits in 3D, slowing as each lands on the figure, the unit card flips in last, and the cards tip backwards one by one to exit.

name: Countdown Dial
description: A glowing ring charges full then drains backwards to the remaining share; the 60 bezel ticks dim as the pulsing head passes, the lost arc shows as dashed red, and the centre figure counts down from the total.

name: Battery Level
description: A battery outline draws on and charges full, then drains to the percentage while the fill shifts green to gold to red with a moving sheen and the percent counts beside it; low levels pulse a red warning, and label 'up' charges instead with a lightning bolt.

name: Thermometer Rise
description: A glass thermometer draws on beside a headline; the mercury springs up a degree scale, shifting from cool cyan through gold to heat red, the live reading rides the top of the column on a pointer, and a heat glow pulses round the bulb.

name: Live Population Clock
description: A lower-left tag on the footage: a cyan LIVE dot pulses, the big figure lands like an odometer and then keeps ticking upward digit by digit, with a data pulse running along its rule.

sample.text: people sharing one planet's fresh water
sample.subtitle: World population

name: Impact Number Burst
description: A contracting ring and inward speed lines build tension, then the figure slams in from blur with a white flash, camera shake, two shockwave rings and a radial spark burst, and gold embers drift up while it holds.

sample.text: People without safely managed drinking water
sample.subtitle: WHO / UNICEF 2023

name: Segmented Meter
description: Twenty slanted segments of rising height light in sequence with a bright leading edge, overshoot past the share and fall back like a VU meter while a white peak-hold segment drops after them, the figure rolling in above.

name: Stopwatch Timer
description: An analog stopwatch swings in, its crown clicks, the gold hand sweeps with an elapsed arc and a turning sub-dial while a mono chrono readout runs, then the crown clicks again and it stops on the duration with a pulse ring.

sample.text: For the flood wave to reach Johnstown

name: Spinning Globe
description: A lit orthographic globe with an atmosphere rim spins in from the west and eases onto the place while pushing in, the country tints in the accent, a map pin drops with a spring bounce, ripples roll out and a leader line draws to the place name, kicker and coordinates rising letter by letter.

sample.text: The reservoir that keeps 25 million people alive
sample.subtitle: Nevada, USA

name: State Glow
description: A dark US map where the camera eases toward the state holding the place, its outline draws on, then it fills from the bottom like a tank with a wavy bright-crested surface and glows while the other states dim, the state name rising letter by letter on the opposite side (falls back to the country outside the US).

sample.text: Wells are running dry across the valley

name: Arc Flight
description: On a dark world map a great-circle arc lifts off the first place and draws to the second with a glowing comet head and fading trail over a faint dotted ground track, the distance (or value) rolls on an odometer at the apex and the destination bursts with rings as the head lands.

sample.text: The dam upstream that Egypt fears
sample.subtitle: The Nile

name: Impact Radius
description: A zone snaps open around the place at its true radius on a dark vector map, the land inside tints in the accent, a range dial of ticks writes itself around the edge and slowly turns, sonar rings run out to the boundary and a measured radius line carries the rolling value + unit.

sample.text: Evacuated within days, still closed today
sample.subtitle: Exclusion zone

name: Choropleth Lift
description: Several states (or countries) shaded from slate to the accent by their item values rise off the dark map one by one as extruded 3D blocks, taller for bigger values, each value rolling on top while a needle on the gradient legend slides to that value.

sample.text: Share of each state in severe drought
sample.label: % of land area

name: Pinboard List
description: Numbered accent badge pins fall onto a dark map one after another with a spring bounce and ground ripple, and at the same beat the matching numbered row of a list on the left rises out of its mask and takes the accent highlight.

sample.text: Cities that came close to running dry
sample.subtitle: Day Zero

name: Coordinate HUD
description: A cyan targeting screen: a scan line sweeps the grid, a full-frame crosshair slides onto the place while mono LAT/LON readouts tick toward its coordinates and the outline map zooms in, then the reticle closes, squares up and locks in the accent with a flash before the name rises beside it.

sample.text: The reservoir behind it hit a record low
sample.subtitle: Location confirmed

name: River Draw
description: On a dark dotted-ridge backdrop with frosted-glass land, a meandering glowing line draws through every place in order with bright water dashes streaming downstream along it, waypoints pop as the head passes, and the start and end are named with the value rolling at the end.

sample.text: The river that supplies 40 million people
sample.subtitle: Colorado River

name: Country Spotlight
description: The world map dims under an accent spotlight while the country holding the place lifts off the sheet toward the camera with a 3D tilt and growing shadow, leaving a dashed hole behind, floats large with a pulsing pin, and drops back into its hole at the end.

sample.text: The first major city to nearly run out of water
sample.subtitle: Cape Town

name: Zoom Box Inset
description: A country (or lower-48) outline draws on at left, a focus box draws around the place, then the box itself flies out along dashed connectors and grows into a large magnified inset on the right with a fine lat/lon grid, scale bar and a dropping pin, shrinking back into the box at the end.

name: Ink Bleed Title
description: Black ink blooms over the shot from three points with crinkled, creeping edges and a soft wet spread until it fills the frame, the title rises letter by letter in white under a gold kicker and rule, then the ink opens from the centre with the same ragged edge and gives the picture back.

name: Anamorphic Light Streak
description: An anamorphic light streak with a white core, gold glow, hot spot and hexagonal lens ghosts sweeps across the footage and its light writes the title letter by letter as it passes; a weaker glint sweeps back at the end and lifts the letters away.

name: Floating Dust Motes
description: Soft dust motes at three depths (far specks, mid motes, near bokeh) drift and rise slowly through a warm shaft of light over the footage, flaring as they cross the beam, with an optional source line and year rising low left beside a gold rule.

name: HUD Grid Scan
description: A thin HUD grid draws out from the centre over the footage with closing corner brackets and a top ruler, a cyan scan line with a phosphor trail sweeps down and up lighting the grid crossings it passes, mono readouts type in, and the subject rises low left under its typed coordinates.

name: Film Burn Flash
description: Warm light floods in from the right edge with flicker and a light leak, then the film burns through with a white-hot hole, charred rim, glowing edge and flying embers before fading back to the shot, while an optional date or era rises letter by letter low left.

name: Geometric Shape Wipe
description: Skewed bars and triangles in ink, gold and white whip across the frame as a staggered group with a smeared motion blur, and the trailing gold dash parks as the underline of an optional word that rises low left, then whips out with it at the end.

name: Gradient Mesh Title
description: A slow gold, slate and charcoal gradient mesh blooms open from the centre through a soft circular edge and keeps drifting with a sheen crossing it, while a centred title rises letter by letter with its kicker, split gold rule and subtitle.

name: Glitch Slice Burst
description: Three short digital bursts slice the picture into horizontal bands shifted sideways with cyan and gold colour splits, a double image, an inverted band, block artefacts and scanlines, while an optional alert line rises low left and jitters colour-split with each burst.

name: Speed Line Tunnel
description: Tapered speed lines stream from the edges into the centre with a white and gold impact ring and a flash, settling to a steady drift while a short line punches in letter by letter with a scale slam inside the clear zone, then the lines rush in and vanish.

name: Paper Tear Reveal
description: A sheet of textured paper slides up over the shot with the title printed on it, cracks along a jagged line with a shudder and tears into two halves that hinge open and fly apart with white fibrous edges, shadows and scraps, revealing the footage beneath.

name: Breaking Flag
description: / A red broadcast tab pops in the top-left corner; the white BREAKING panel swings out of it on a hinge, then the dark headline panel swings out of that one (each shaded while it is turned away). At the end they fold back in reverse and the tab closes. /
